entities.summary: Kitts, a notable figure in the history of Saint Kitts and Nevis, associated with Indigenous Peoples of Liamuiga and Oualie (3000 BCE–800). Preceded by Ciboney and Arawak Settlement. Their legacy influenced Kalinago (Carib) Dominance and Kalinago establish dominance over Liamuiga and Oualie by c. 1300.
